response.sql: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) as avg_amount FROM trans WHERE type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') GROUP BY account_id), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as mean_value FROM account_averages) SELECT aa.account_id, aa.avg_amount, aa.avg_amount - om.mean_value as difference FROM account_averages aa CROSS JOIN overall_mean om WHERE aa.avg_amount > om.mean_value ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
